summary: stui's local quality counters add three histograms for sending a message (press send to the box showing it, to st accepting it, to the conversation holding it as sent) with starting targets of p99 100 ms and 200 ms, and its hourly line limit rises to 256 KB

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. stui's local hourly line gains three histogram keys and two targets (version 1 reference fixture updated).

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: stui-only change against any member; the line stays on the device.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
